capabilities_done: F-R55-5: one helper, derived_text::derive_text, at every site that copies story text into generated or derived text: TOC entries in generate_toc and generate_table_of_contents (TocEntryOut.text, TocContractEntry.text, the generated story, TocBookmark.title), running text, cross-reference paragraph text (fullPara, paraText, partial paragraph), endnote text and captured index topics. clean, clean_keeping and entry_text are gone

notes.behaviour_change: Cross-reference text now trims U+2029 and the other terminators, where it trimmed only U+000A and U+000D. An inner terminator in a character-style range, a note body or a captured selection is a space. U+FFFC leaves entry text. An index topic can no longer be captured from a selection holding a page-number, section or cross-reference marker or a reserved code point. New public fields: marker_gaps on five result structs, resolved_text on NoteHost
